errors.evidence: The description incorrectly describes the color of 'Universal Quantifiers' as 'very light gray-blue' instead of 'light blue' as shown in the figure.

The description does not explicitly state that the set of three pie charts represents different categories or concepts: 'Categorical,' 'Approximate Number Generation,' and 'Disjunctive & Conjunctive.'
The description does not explicitly mention that the segments do not follow a specific order based on size, though it implies this.

errors.text_span: The pie chart titled “Categorical” presents the distribution of four categorical classes, shown as four slices with percentage labels inside each segment and no separate legend; the slices are Limiter (light pink) at about 27.91%, Universal Quantifiers (very light gray-blue) at about 29.07%, Negation (light orange/peach) at about 27.91%, and Existential Quantifiers (pale green) at about 15.12%, with no slices visually exploded or otherwise emphasized and no clear ordering by size apparent from the layout.
errors.evidence: The description is overly detailed and repetitive, particularly in describing the absence of a legend, visual emphasis, and ordering multiple times.

errors.text_span: The pie chart titled “Approximate Number Generation” shows the proportional breakdown across three categories, with three slices labeled directly with percentages and no legend; the segments are Approximate Quantities (pale beige/cream) at about 45.03%, Comparative Relationships (light blue) at about 36.26%, and Absolute Absence (light lavender) at about 18.71%, and the chart uses standard contiguous slices without offsets or bold emphasis and without an obvious systematic ordering beyond the displayed arrangement.
